notes.content:
Hi players,

Another small update to the game. Mainly branding related but it also adds two levels to the [i]Growth [/i]and [i]Food [/i]upgrades.

Happy playing!
nkm

====================

Changes:
[list]
[*] new: Growth III and Growth IV upgrades
[*] new: Food III and Food IV upgrades
[*] changed: branding graphics
[*] changed: wave mob amount tweaking
[*] changed: increased Breeding Ground production
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.6 released!
notes.content:
Hi Piranha Feeding players,

This new update adds some much requested gameplay tweaks and fixes as well as some new prey to bite your teeth into!

More coming soon...

Happy playing!
nkm

[b]Change list:[/b]
[list]
[*] new: WASD-SPACE controls are now enabled in title screen as alternatives to ARROWS-ENTER controls
[*] new: header bar now shows coin count
[*] new: food animation
[*] new: Iron Scale upgrades. Decrease bullet damage.
[*] new: Yellow Starfish prey
[*] changed: aquarium background graphics
[*] changed: building activator is now placed at the bottom to reduce chance of accidental hits
[*] changed: snake now shoots at a lower firing rate and less often
[*] changed: added an extra slot to the Breeding Ground
[*] changed: the appearance of food items, to make them distinguishable from bullets
[*] changed: start with one additional piranha and a bullet eater
[*] changed: piranhas are a bit more agressive by default
[*] fixed: issue that caused piranhas to try to move outside the aquarium
[/list]
